♐ Sagittarius is ascendant today. Your Cloth is awake. For the whole day your Techniques heighten as though you were 4 levels higher, and you have your Ascendant Boon.

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Golden Arrow]'s range increment becomes one mile; it ignores all cover, concealment, and the hidden and undetected conditions, and can strike any creature whose location you can name even without line of sight.

Automation note: the fly Speed is automatic. The range and detection clauses are not — pf2e has no rule element for "ignore cover and concealment" or "target without detecting," and Foundry has no way to aim at a creature purely by name. This half stays the table's to grant, the way Titan's Stance's retargeting does.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. Applied and removed by the module's sky tracker; a GM can also drag it on by hand.
